rationale: Residues Gly8, Ala9, Gly10, Gly11 and Val12 of the 399-residue form contact NADP within 4.0 A in 8H52. These positions do not exist in the 385-residue O26037 sequence, so the term can only be annotated coherently against the corrected 399-residue product.

go_term: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-NH group of donors, NAD(P) as acceptor
rationale: 8H52 is deposited as H. pylori carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase with NADP bound; RefSeq assigns EC 1.5.1.- to WP_015056101.1.

Carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase is the first step of the CASDH / CASDC route to spermidine (PMID 22025614), and H. pylori lacks the canonical spermidine synthase route (PMID 28648602). H. pylori 26695 enzyme activity has not been assayed directly in the retrieved literature.

current_or_proposed: legacy (from the O26037 product name 'conserved hypothetical ATP-binding protein')
rationale: The product name is a 1997 GenBank guess based on a Rossmann-like motif. The structure shows an NADP-binding Rossmann fold with a 2'-phosphate specificity patch (Arg35 NE 2.73 A, Ser36 OG 2.38 A, Lys39 NZ 2.41 A). No ATP evidence exists.
Soluble NADP-dependent dehydrogenase with no signal peptide or transmembrane prediction. Weak and non-specific; include only if the review requires a CC term.

recommended_action: record as a sequence-annotation note on the review, not a GO term
rationale: The native 26695 product is predicted to begin at the TTG at AE000511.1:1580280 and to be 399 residues (WP_015056101.1), 14 residues longer than O26037. Residue numbering in any structure-derived annotation must use the 399-residue frame.
